name: Classycal
tagline: Plan calendar events and Apple Reminders together on your Mac.
description:
Classycal brings events and Apple Reminders into one planner. It supports natural-language entry, calendar views from day to year, and task lists for deadlines and priorities.

## Privacy and requirements
The Mac app requires macOS 26 and uses the calendar and reminder accounts already configured on your device. Classycal does not require its own account.

## Pricing
Basic planning is free. Classycal Plus offers an annual subscription and a lifetime unlock that also works on iPhone.
pricingDetails: Free, Plus from $20 per year or $60 lifetime
